title: Continual Learning for Reliable In-Sequence Molecular Communication
abstract: arXiv:2610.20426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper considers reliable in-sequence molecular communication, where bio-nanomachines exchange molecule-encoded information in a specified order, and investigates a new simulation-based method to incrementally evaluate communication protocols by gradually increasing the complexity of experimental settings. The proposed method, called Affine Memory Replay (AMR), builds a continual learning (CL) model to estimate communication performance between bio-nanomachines. AMR stores past simulation samples and synthesizes additional replay samples through interpolation and extrapolation between past samples. Through incremental performance estimation tasks, it replays both past and synthetic samples to regularize model updates, helping the model adapt to new experimental settings while retaining knowledge from earlier ones. translated_title: 面向可靠序列内分子通信的持续学习
translated_abstract: 本文研究可靠的序列内分子通信，即生物纳米机器按指定顺序交换以分子编码的信息，并提出一种新的基于仿真的方法，通过逐步增加实验设置的复杂度来增量式评估通信协议。所提出的方法称为仿射记忆回放（AMR），其构建一个持续学习（CL）模型来估计生物纳米机器之间的通信性能。AMR存储过去的仿真样本，并通过在过往样本之间进行插值与外推来合成额外的回放样本。在增量式性能估计任务中，它同时回放过往样本和合成样本以正则化模型更新，帮助模型在适应新实验设置的同时保留先前设置的知识。实验结果表明，AMR在保持整体估计精度方面显著优于现有的持续学习方法。
tldr: 本文提出仿射记忆回放（AMR）方法，通过存储历史仿真样本并利用插值与外推合成回放样本，在实验设置复杂度逐步递增的序列内分子通信中实现通信性能的增量估计，在适应新设置的同时保持整体估计精度。
